about.intro: I'm a *Civil Engineer* and *Commercial & Procurement Specialist* focused on **end-to-end contract and billing management**.
about.description: Construction professional with **7+ years of experience** in **procurement**, **billing**, and **contract administration** for residential and commercial projects. I combine a *technical engineering foundation* with hands-on commercial discipline to keep projects running cleanly from paper to payment.
about.full:
Hi, I'm **Abhishek Ramjiyani**. My work sits at the intersection of engineering and commercial management – I started with a technical foundation in **civil engineering**, and over time moved into the commercial side of project delivery, focusing on **procurement**, **contract administration**, and **RA billing**.

I manage the full commercial lifecycle of a project end-to-end from vendor qualification and rate negotiation, through subcontract finalization and contract administration, to accurate and timely **RA (Running Account) Billing** for both **clients and subcontractors.** Having an engineering background means i understand the technical scope behind every line item, which helps me manage commercial decisions with more precision than a purely administrative approach would allow.

I care about **financial control**  – that's tight and transparent material reconciliation, real-time budget tracking, variation pricing, and making sure billing reflects work accurately and on time. It's not just paperwork, it's giving a project's commercial side the same discipline its technical side demands.

My goal is to keep strengthening this blend of technical and commercial expertise, taking on more responsibility across procurement strategy, contract structuring, and project financial management as I grow.

**Software & Skills** – AutoCAD, MS Excel & Office, STAAD Pro (Basic), Planwin.
 **Core Strengths** – Procurement Management, Billing Management, Contract Administration, Commercial Management with strong problem-solving ability, attention to detail, and effective communication across project teams.

experience.description:
Directing the end-to-end procurement lifecycle, vendor qualification, rate negotiation, and subcontract finalization to protect project margins.
Overseeing the full RA billing lifecycle for clients and subcontractors, ensuring flawless verification and timely submission.
Enforcing financial control through material reconciliation and real-time budget tracking against baseline estimates.
Handling contract administration, variation pricing, and cash flow management across receivables, payables, and fund allocation.
Serving as the primary commercial point of contact for vendors and subcontractors, resolving billing disputes and contractual bottlenecks, while leading and mentoring the commercial team.

Certified complex subcontractor invoices, cross-verifying physical site measurements against BOQ terms. 
Ran material reconciliation audits to identify wastage patterns and drive cost recoveries. 
Negotiated, quantified, and drafted rate analysis reports for non-tendered extra items and project variations. 
Audited commercial billing cycles for alignment with contract terms, using MS Excel models and AutoCAD verification to accelerate bill clearance.

Drafted routine subcontractor bills and compiled daily site measurement logs with site engineers. 
Assisted material reconciliation by matching theoretical consumption against physical gate entries. 
Logged on-site variation entries and extra item requests for senior review. 
Maintained measurement books (MB) and performed quantity take-offs from structural drawings.

Prepared AutoCAD drawings and assisted in structural design coordination between consulting teams and field execution units. 
Conducted routine site inspections to verify on-ground structural work complied with approved technical drawings.

Supervised daily on-site civil construction activities to ensure adherence to design specifications, timelines, and safety standards. 
Supported project administration through preliminary quantity estimations, daily progress reporting, and basic documentation tracking.
